question: Should the schema-v4-to-v6 database migration and expanded portable-store contract ship based on the focused exact-head tests, or require copied-store upgrade proof first?
rationale: Code review can assess migration mechanics, but the acceptable release-proof threshold and long-term persistence compatibility contract require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept focused tests
options.body: After removing the changelog entries, approve the exact head because its targeted migration and foreign-key coverage is sufficient for this release.

options.title: Require copied-store proof
options.body: Hold merge until a copied schema-v4 database and portable store show redacted before/after doctor, coverage, summarize, and cluster output.

recommendation.title: Accept focused tests
recommendation.body: After removing the changelog entries, approve the exact head because its targeted migration and foreign-key coverage is sufficient for this release.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history has the strongest ownership of the affected storage, clustering, synchronization, vector, and SQLite compatibility contracts.
